title: Amazon EventBridge scheduled invocation to AWS Batch
description: Create an EventBridge event bus and route events to AWS Batch on a schedule.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The EventBridge rule specified in `template.yaml` uses the default event bus to schedule a trigger for AWS Batch. There are two ways to schedule the trigger - using a cron expression or a rate expression. The template has examples for both.
Please uncomment the one you want to use. The AWS Batch job is triggered based on the specified schedule.
